data: In fiscal 2024, which ended September 28, 2024, Apple reported total net sales of about $391.0 billion ($391,035 million), up roughly 2% from $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023. Cost of sales was about $210.4 billion, which left gross profit of roughly $180.7 billion ($180,683 million). That works out to a gross margin of about 46.2%, compared with 44.1% in fiscal 2023. Within that total, products had a gross margin of about 37.2% and services about 73.9%. After operating expenses of about $57.5 billion, split between roughly $31.4 billion for research and development and $26.1 billion for selling, general and administrative costs, operating income was about $123.2 billion ($123,216 million). That gives an operating margin of roughly 31.5%, up from about 29.8% in fiscal 2023.
